headline: Adderstone Construction secures Stanley House contract in Falkland Islands
summary: Adderstone Construction (Falkland Islands) Limited won a government contract for Stanley House following its recent completion of the FIGAS aircraft hangar in Port Stanley.
why: Government infrastructure tenders in remote territories provide stable revenue backlogs for regional contracting firms.

impacts.name: Adderstone Group
impacts.why: Securing public works agreements builds project revenue in British Overseas Territories.
